d: A circle skirt block drafted with the compass method from classic British pattern cutting

lengthBonus.d: How much longer than the knee measurement the skirt should be, measured on the fold edge. The book's own table runs from a 70 cm short skirt to a 105 cm evening skirt

fullness.d: How much of a circle the skirt sweeps. The same quarter-circle base pattern serves them all, used one to four times

fullness.full.d: The quarter-circle base pattern used four times, for the widest hem the book gives

fullness.threeQuarter.d: The quarter-circle base pattern used three times

fullness.half.d: The quarter-circle base pattern used twice, for about 60% of the full circle's hem

fullness.quarter.d: The quarter-circle base pattern used once, the least full of the family

hipSafetyMargin.d: How much to add to the waist before drafting, so the hip does not come out tight on a block that is sized from the waist alone. It is taken back out as a waist dart at each side seam. The book adds 4 to 5 cm
